desc: The RAPIDE DAWN. A truly unique 1911 with stepped cocking serrations, slide lightening cuts for faster Slide lock-up and TiN coated barrel for extreme durability. Equipped with Kimber Stiplex TM front strap stippling and Gray/Black G10 Rapide patterned grips for extra griping confidence. Kimpro Silver finish with brush polished flats finish off the stunning looks.
